prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for specific kinds of change because no kind of change has at least 2 tests yet.
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no tests produced a statistically significant win.
No clear effect was seen for new home flows (home, new_flow) or path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign).
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic and too high, especially for sign-in reordering where a +20.0% gain was predicted but a loss occurred.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +2.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Setup & Verification Guide: Add a dedicated desktop display permission and visibility verification screen right after pet asset generation. (why: Support emails show 3 users experienced issues where the pet does not appear on the desktop or the app fails to open, causing high waiting drop-offs.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Layout: Redesign home_intro to a split layout with interactive control tips showing how to interact, hide, or manage the desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet post-onboarding, leading to finish step abandonment.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Synchronization Clarification Reorder: Add cloud sync verification messaging directly onto the sign-in screen to clarify account pet recovery. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again with different or unlinked accounts.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Adopt Companion Multi-Step Preview Flow: Insert a custom pet creation preview review screen prior to final adoption certification. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted visual results, contributing to a 60.9% adoption conversion rate and long durations.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync & Pet Recovery Sign-In Note: Update sign-in screen text to emphasize restoring existing desktop pets and preventing accidental duplicate accounts. (why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets due to signing in with secondary accounts after initial setup.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Time Estimator: Display explicit progress indicators and time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop pet graphics build. (why: The waiting step has an extreme mean duration of 2336s and 81.3% conversion due to unclear background processing status.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint: Add image quality guidance hints to the photo upload screen. (why: Support logs show 3 custom pet generation bugs caused by bad source images during adoption.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Compact Path Selection Layout: Switch the path choice screen layout to a compact presentation to reduce decision friction. (why: Choose path screen has a long mean time of 514 seconds; streamlining the options helps users decide quickly.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop Asset Completion Desktop Notification: Enable background notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when desktop initialization finishes. (why: Waiting step has a mean duration of over 38 minutes (2336s), indicating users switch away while waiting for graphics generation.)

Target step adoption has the lowest conversion (60.9%), but adding multi-step flows risks increasing friction.
